scope: Selected phrase outgoing pair with trailing punctuation; 8 suffixes × 2 selection padding variants; independent prior evidence and repeated witness
cause: Outgoing reconciliation required raw whitespace-delimited next span to be a word, unlike ordinary learning which removes prose punctuation. Thus old pair survived and corrected outgoing pair was absent.
implementation: Normalize next span with PersonalHistory.tokenize while preserving exact raw occurrence body; match normalized token and owned old pair before retract/reobserve.

native_ui.scope: Actual extension literal/number/period/missing-space/personal-inflection/long phrase and selected phrase prediction/retraction; punctuation pair assertion is core evidence
